disagreements.note: Contrast is Paris A1b vs A1a (age-at-diagnosis category) among Crohn's patients; age, not disease
Viral challenge study (RSV vs rhinovirus inoculation of volunteers)
Invasive vs non-invasive oesophageal SCC cells engineered with hTERT/EGFR over-expression (cell culture)
Operationally tolerant vs standard-immunotherapy transplant recipients: tolerance/treatment status, not disease
Within lung-cancer patients, nodule site vs contralateral site lining fluid: sampling site
Levels 'normal airway epithelia' vs 'normal' in a field-cancerization study: a sampling-site contrast, not disease vs control (second pass: exclude)
HBV-associated HCC, malignant vs non-malignant liver tissue/hepatocytes ('not applicable' read as non-malignant)
Second pass: CML patients split by cytogenetic response to imatinib are treatment-response groups, not a disease state (rule fixed while reviewing ST000919 and MTBLS92)
AML 'Type A' vs 'Non-Type A' groups not identifiable as a clinical disease state from the metadata (second pass: exclude)
Contrast labelled 'treatment' vs 'control group' in a Parkinson's olfactory study; description suggests patients vs controls but the label implies treatment (second pass: exclude)
PCOS vs control; clamp/OGTT sampling applied to both groups, contrast is disease
Overweight vs healthy weight: a BMI category, not a disease (unlike obesity)
